title: Function coverage analogue for Reset with minimal parameter
purpose: Create another valid SendRRData explicit-message seed with a different inferred service byte and small request body to diversify service dispatch while preserving all documented framing rules.
expected_behavior: Parser should accept a compact but complete explicit-message request over SendRRData and route it through CPF parsing into the CIP layer; final service handling is implementation dependent.
constraints_preserved: Used EtherNet/IP encapsulation command 0x006f and the documented 24-byte header.
Set payload length 0x0017 to exactly match the CPF bytes following the header.
Preserved documented CPF structure with two items: Null Address Item and Unconnected Data Item.
Set the unconnected item length to 0x000b matching the 11-byte CIP request.
Used a conservative inferred CIP service byte 0x05 as a Reset-themed placeholder because the exact Reset service code is not present in supplied sources.
Used conservative inferred EPATH bytes 0x20 0x01 0x24 0x01 and path-size value 0x02; this assumption is recorded rather than presented as source-verified.
issue_safety_notes: No vulnerability, fault, or reset effect is asserted. This is a safe structural corpus seed for parser and dispatcher coverage.
